text:
tess_sales: Quick heads-up 0% discount POC request from Axiom Health. They want to trial their axiom-30b-utf8-q4kv variant for a 6-week POC. Must-haves: FIPS KMS, EU data residency, and kv-prefix caching. Can we check catalog fit + onboarding effort and a rough POC price?

sam_se: On it. Two immediate checks: (1) tokenizer differences? (2) any nonstandard special tokens in their prompt set? If tokenizer differs we can ship a small adapter.

tess_sales: They mentioned a "utf8-compat" tokenizer with extra glyph normalization and a custom   token. Provided sample prompts (50 short conversations).

sam_se: I'll run our verify tool now:
```
redwood model verify --model axiom-30b --variant q4kv --tokenizer utf8-compat --prompts ./axiom_samples.json
```
Expect: token mapping warnings, kv-cache OK, q4 kernel path should be fine on Ampere-class GPUs.

rui_infra: Performance note: FIPS pushes us away from Hosted unless they accept bring-your-own-KMS in Dedicated. For p50 SLOs we need to know target latency and concurrency. Do they have a latency SLO?

tess_sales: They want interactive latency: p50 <150ms for 1k-context at typical concurrency ~10. Also need audit logs and SAML SSO.

kariom_sec: (karim_sec) FIPS requirement = blocker for fully-managed hosted. Two paths: (A) Dedicated with customer-managed FIPS HSM in their VPC + our audit forwarding, or (B) Private/on-prem deployment. Ask them which they prefer. Also need to collect compliance contact and any supplier security questionnaire.

sam_se: Verify output summary (local run):
- tokenizer: extra glyph normalization + custom token ( ) -> adapter required (small mapping + strip)
- kv-cache: supported (no runtime change)
- quant path: q4kv uses mixed-int8 ops, runtime has kernel support on A100 and H100, good perf projections
- estimated engineering: adapter + tests ~4 hours; one PR + benching

sam_se: Example adapter (node):
```js
// normalize glyphs and remove custom token
function normalize(text){
  return text.replace(/\u00A0/g, ' ').replace(/<NBSP>/g, '');
}
module.exports = { normalize }
```

rui_infra: For the latency target (p50 <150ms @ 1k ctx, concurrency 10): Dedicated with 3x A100-equivalents with prefix caching should meet it. Rough POC pricing for 6 weeks and 500k tokens/day:
- Dedicated (eu-central): ~$8k total for 6 weeks (incl. infra reserve + support + benching)
- Private/on-prem: one-time install + support (~$25k) not including customer infra
If they accept BYO-FIPS in Dedicated we can stay in eu region and add audit log forwarding.

karim_sec: I'll draft a short compliance checklist: required evidence (FIPS cert, KMS attestation, SOC2 snippets), network diagram for Dedicated, and SAML connector requirements. ETA 48h.

tess_sales: Action items: (1) I'll ask Axiom for compliance contact + confirm whether Dedicated with BYO-HSM is acceptable, (2) send their sample prompts to Sam, (3) confirm retention/PD deletion SLAs.

sam_se: I'll open a PR with adapter + unit tests and tag @rui_infra for bench runs.

bench-bot: bench-job queued (id: bj-99231). Will post micro-bench results here when complete.

tess_sales: Thanks! I'll update the customer and push the compliance contact here once I have it. :pray:
